text:
📊 WhatsApp ad test (2 din, ₹90 kharch): 30 log ne WhatsApp chat shuru kiya, ek chat sirf ~₹3 ka. Lead form mein ek lead ₹10-20 ka padta tha. Ye 4-6 guna sasta hai. 16 logon ne 2+ message bheje.

Shobhit: in 30 chats ka jawab 5 min ke andar dena sabse zaroori hai. Meta ke 72 ghante free hote hain follow-up ke liye.

WhatsApp chat ka pehla jawab (copy karo):

Namaste 🙏 VAJRA PP shuttering sheet, 8x4 ft, 12 mm. Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai.
Bataiye: 1) kaunsa kaam (slab/column)? 2) kitna area (sq ft)? 3) kaunsa sheher? Hisaab bana ke bhejta hoon.

Jo jawab na de, 24 ghante baad ye bhejo (72 ghante ke andar):

Namaste ji, aapne VAJRA sheet ke baare mein poocha tha. Free sample chahiye ya godown/site pe dekhna chahenge? Bas area aur sheher bata dijiye.
Har chat pe label lagao: Naya / Rate bheja / Sample / Order. Har Monday main report mein poochunga kitne Order bane, taaki pata chale kaunsa ad sach mein bikri la raha hai.
